en: Don't I wish I could. I doubt my interviewers are gonna be as understandin' as you are, Akiyama-san.
Everyone's nervous. Just do what you can to prepare beforehand.
Yeah, I guess yer right there. But there's another thing I've been frettin' about lately.
Oh? What's that?
I'm thinkin' maybe I should forget the whole Tokyo accent thing, and focus all my time on gettin' hired here in Osaka.
I see. That's certainly one option.
Whaddya think, Akiyama-san? Should I limit myself to stuff here in Osaka?
You should. It's more realistic than wasting time taking hiring tests for jobs you have no hope of landing.
Why do ya gotta say it like that? Ya make it sound like I've got no chance of passin'!
What? You do lack confidence in yourself, right?
Yeah, so I wanted ya to encourage me, Akiyama-san!
What kind of logic is that?
Ooh, now I'm fumin'! At this point, I'm gonna land a job at a big network no matter what!
Hey, I guess it's good you're fired up now.
Don't do that. If you give up on your dreams, then you're bound to regret it someday.
Yeah, you're right. I've been thinkin' the same thing, but I'm not at an age where I can keep dreamin' forever anymore. I'm wonderin' what to do.
The regret of trying and failing is different than the regret of never having tried at all. The decision is yours to make.
Okay, then that settles it. I'm gonna try for a national network!
All right. Good luck.
Much obliged for the advice, Akiyama-san!
Decide for yourself. You'll regret putting major life decisions in another person's hands.
I'm not sayin' I'm gonna do whatever ya happen to tell me to! I'm just askin' for yer opinion is all.
I'm willin' to bet ya don't even care either way, huh?
Hey, come on now.
Are you backing down?
I ain't even!
No, maybe you're right. I think ya mighta hit the nail right on the head and so I lashed out. Sorry for snappin' at ya.
It's okay to back down. Knowing your own limits is an important ability. That judgment is bound to serve you well further down the line.
You don't sound terribly convinced.
You can see right through me, Akiyama-san.
I wanna work for a national network. It ain't easy to give up on my dreams like that.
I see. Well, better do your best.
Why the lack of confidence? If you don't go into this process thinking that you're going to pass, then you're never going to.
You're right! I wasn't thinkin' straight!
Thanks for givin' me a kick in the pants, Akiyama-san! I'm gonna get a job at a national network for sure!
Now there's the Honoka-chan I know.
You sure you can land a local job?
Um, well...
Aren't you giving yourself a little too much credit? Don't confuse confidence with arrogance. It'll hurt you big if you mess things up.
That's not all. Setting the bar lower also lessens your dreams. Would you be satisfied with making those lesser dreams come true?
Hmph. Yeah. Thanks for callin' me out on that, Akiyama-san. If ya hadn't, I woulda wound up wastin' all the effort I'd put into this.
I'm glad you understand what I'm getting at.
Hehe! I like that ya don't beat around the bush, Akiyama-san.
So I was just at this seminar, and boy am I super tired.
A job-hunting seminar?
More like a study session. An actual newscaster came to offer us some trainin', including some interview testin'.
It's indispensable stuff for folks wantin' to be newscasters. It was super popular, but somehow I managed to nab a spot in the final session.
I didn't know they had things like that. Was it a good experience for you?
Weeell...
Did it go well?
Hehe! 'Course it did! How could ya tell?
By looking at your face. You've been grinning ear to ear this whole time.
Aw, have I? I'm just in a pretty good mood is all, so hopefully you can let it slide.
I don't mind in the least.
Not so hot, huh?
What are ya sayin' that for? Didn't I have this big ol' smile on my face?
Yer hopeless, Akiyama-san. What a buzzkill.
Oh. Well, so long as it went well.
Anyways, in this seminar, if they think ya've got the chops, they let ya move on to a higher level, and I managed to make the cut!
Well, how about that! Guess that shows you what having enough confidence in yourself can do.
Yep! If I hadn't made the cut I was ready to give up on things, so I'm super relieved.
How the heck did you manage that? Before you were freaking out over not being good enough.
I been workin' my butt off since then, that's how! I've been voice chattin' with my Tokyo friends to help me practice my accent.
I see. Your efforts seem to have borne fruit.
The person who told me 'bout the seminar is from Osaka too, and they said they could tell I'd been workin' on my pronunciation.
Keep at it. This advanced seminar is your chance to give it your all before it's time for the real deal.
Yeah. Maybe I shouldn't work here at the club as much, so that I don't kill my momentum?
It's a critical time for you. Taking some time off might not be a bad idea.
Hmm, good point. I'll hafta have a talk with my manager.
Don't rest on your laurels. All you've done so far is get yourself on equal footing with people from Tokyo. The real struggle starts from here.
Yeah, that's right! I've been so focused on my accent trainin' that I mighta let some of my fundamentals slip.
I'll hafta work on those fundamentals before the next seminar comes up. Much obliged for helpin' me out with stuff, Akiyama-san.
Hey, it's fun for me to watch you make progress.
You're welcome. I can see I've had an impact on you by coming here.
What the hey!? Yer welcome, nothin'! I'm the one who's been doin' all the hard work!
But haven't I given you lots of advice? Don't you think that's been a huge part of it?
Sure, but don't ya think I deserve credit for puttin' in the effort based on that advice?
If anyone deserves to be complimented here, it's me. You're so selfish, Akiyama-san.
My apologies, then.
Um, hey, Akiyama-san?
Hirin' exams for newscasters are finally startin'!
Oh wow. This has been a long time coming.
I'm in the final stretch. What should I do?
Do what you've been doing. You've got some good momentum, so don't do anything odd that could throw your rhythm off.
Yeah. It's not gonna do me any good if I wind up gettin' all hasty at this point.
I'll stick with my usual trainin'.
You don't have to do anything. Just make sure to be ready for the final test and stay healthy.
Hmm. Ya think so? I feel like I could still improve in some areas, so don't ya think I oughta work a bit harder?
Any sort of training can be bad for your health if you overdo it. If you don't set reasonable limits, it could backfire on you.
Right. You're so coolheaded, Akiyama-san! I can't think that calmly.
Come to think of it, my throat ain't feelin' so good lately. Maybe I got a cold?
That wouldn't be good. Do you have a fever?
I don't think so. And I'm not coughin'. Maybe my voice is just shot from talkin' too much? Some hot tea oughta make it better.
That's a relief. It'd be terrible for you to get sick at this stage of the game.
No way I'm lettin' that happen! That'd be a really lame joke!
I hope it's just a joke. It wouldn't be funny if there were actually something wrong with your throat.
Yeah. I guess I should be more careful. I'll try not to push myself too hard.
Yeah, that's not a bad idea.
Are you sure you're all right? Something definitely seems off.
Hey now, why are ya bein' so serious? Stop tryin' to scare me. I'm fine, I swear.
I sure hope you're right...
Go to a clinic right away. You want to get examined by a doctor before it gets worse.
C'mon, stop scarin' me. I'm just a little worn-out right now is all.
Really? I sure hope it's nothing.
You're such a worrywart, Akiyama-san. You're makin' a big fuss over nothin'.
Hey, come on. I'm concerned about you is all.
I know. And I appreciate the concern.
Sheesh. Could you not make me worry so much?
No. Go see a doctor. Just in case.
What? That's kinda sudden...
Becoming a newscaster is your dream, right? So you can't afford to be careless. Hopefully you go to the clinic and they say it's nothing.
Yeah, okay. I think I can get away after this, so I'll go right away.
Promise me, okay?
Sorry to make ya worry, Akiyama-san.
I'm real sorry about the other day, Akiyama-san.
Is your throat doing better?
Yeah, thanks to you!
So, how did things go?
I... It didn't go well.
And after ya got me that medicine, too. I'm so pathetic.
It's all right. There'll be other tests. Focus on getting healthy and prepare for the next one.
Don't feel bad. You only just started your job search. Use this failure to do better next time.
Yeah! Next time I'll nail it for sure!
My top choice is a big-name station in Tokyo. If I land a job there, I can see ya whenever!
That's right. And when that time comes, your Kansai accent will be all but gone.
I'm only gonna be speakin' with a Tokyo accent when I'm on air. With you I'm gonna be just a girl. My usual self!
That may be unrealistic.
Whaaat!? How come!?
Because newbie newscasters for big networks are like celebrities.
You'd be really busy, and paparazzi will be chasing you around. I doubt we'd have time to date.
Oh no! In that case, maybe I oughta give up on bein' a newscaster...
Hey now...
<Color:255,200,200,255>So I've been thinkin' this for a while now, but you must go to cabaret clubs pretty often, don't ya, Akiyama-san?<Color:Default>
I guess. I like to go out drinking, and it's not nearly as fun to go drinking by myself.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I never pegged ya for a lonely guy.<Color:Default>
Well, I'm a man who's fond of company. I spent a big part of my life alone, so I suppose it's only natural that I'd want to be around people.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hmm. Well, I can keep ya company then!<Color:Default>
Thanks. I'd like that.
Not really. Usually I get my booze at the corner store and have a good time with my buddies.
<Color:255,200,200,255>For real?<Color:Default>
For real. Right now I'm here on business, and don't have my usual friends to go drink with.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Aww, okay.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, ya just seem real used to this sorta thing. You're not nervous at all, y'know. How come you're able to talk so naturally?<Color:Default>
Oh? What do you mean? You seem to be a natural yourself, Honoka-chan.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm no good at that sorta thing. When I'm with someone I like, I clam right up! I can barely even make eye contact with 'em!<Color:Default>
That's so sweet and innocent! It's nothing like the way you usually act.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I can't help it! I get super nervous, and I wind up sweatin' from my palms and stuff!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>When I avert my eyes they think I'm mad, and I blow the whole thing by sayin' somethin' strange. I always mess things up.<Color:Default>
You're kidding. I can't imagine you like that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Stop bein' so rude! I'm serious here!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm not always so chatty. When I get nervous, I mess up by sayin' weird things.<Color:Default>
That's fine. That juxtaposition can be kind of endearing. I'm sure some guy would totally fall for you when he sees that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>When's that gonna be, though? I always wind up havin' stuff cut short 'cause of some misunderstandin'.<Color:Default>
That day is today. I'm here, aren't I?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hah, what? That's such a corny line!<Color:Default>
What can I say? You've changed the way I see you. I'd never have imagined a go-getter like you was so wet behind the ears in terms of love.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I... What're ya talkin' about!? I'm blushin' enough here as it is, so don't say that sorta thing. Ah geez, now I'm sweatin'!<Color:Default>
Don't be so hasty. You're still young, there isn't any rush.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Bein' young's got nothin' to do with it. If I'm not quick enough, maybe some other girl will steal a man right from under me! Love is war!<Color:Default>
The early bird gets the worm, huh? I guess if there's someone you like, you'd better not let yourself get stage fright.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But that's exactly my problem! I honestly don't know what I oughta do!<Color:Default>
You'll get used to it. There's no need to rush. Just let go of your anxiety slowly, bit by bit.
